text_blocks.snippet: Diabetes glucose readings, also known as blood sugar levels, are measured to monitor and manage diabetes. Normal fasting blood glucose levels are typically between 70 and 100 mg/dL (3.9 to 5.6 mmol/L). Prediabetes is diagnosed when fasting blood glucose levels range from 100 to 125 mg/dL (5.6 to 6.9 mmol/L). Diabetes is diagnosed when fasting blood glucose levels are 126 mg/dL (7 mmol/L) or higher on two separate tests.
